did: Built and tested live in the browser pane by hand. The month start day was set to 10 in Settings and the owner opened the monthly report.

checks.text: The monthly report names the real period: 10 October 2026 to 9 November 2026, instead of a calendar month
A month that has ended keeps its figures as they were that night; a memo corrected later shows in a Corrected memos block rather than silently changing last month
The start day is a number from 1 to 28 in Settings; the export to Excel uses the same period

notes: Built this round from the spec (chapter 25). The report page and the Excel file use one period service so they cannot disagree. 8 new automatic tests together with item 551.

shots.caption: The report for 10 October to 9 November
